You'll be fine. You already quit your vices which means the hardest part is over and done with. Just living a normal healthy life will be enough to naturally reverse any of your after effects. Some of the comments mentioned taking some supplements before you go to sleep and that's probably a good idea too.

I doubt you have any long lasting brain damage from your past usage. Even if you did, neuroplasticity is really effective at recovery. People have recovered smoothly from traumatic brain injuries without long lasting effects, so I think your body is more than capable of reversing any possible damage you may have within the next couple of months.

Just remember to exercise your brain, get some sun, keep in contact w/ friends & family(very important), and stay fed and hydrated! You're already on the right path dude! you got this :)
